title: Data Broker
description: Describes a single data broker for delete-me's letter and audit pipelines. One YAML file per broker under registry/brokers/.

id.description: Stable slug; matches filename. Lowercase, alnum + underscore. Never change after publish.

name.description: Legal name of the broker (e.g., 'Spokeo, Inc.').

parent_company.description: If the broker is owned by a larger group (e.g., PeopleConnect for Intelius).

tier.description: Sensible tiering per the project plan.

methods.description: Accepted opt-out channels, ORDERED by preference.

postal.description: Mailing address as a single string.

accepts_authorized_agent.description: Whether the broker accepts CCPA-style authorized-agent designations.

agent_form_requirements.description: Extra requirements the broker imposes on agent letters.

re_aggregation_days.description: Observed/typical days until the broker re-lists a previously removed user.

audit_sources.description: Identifiers of audit adapters (in core-py/delete_me/audit/sources/) used to verify removal.

letter_template.description: Filename of the Jinja2 letter template to use (default: ccpa_authorized_agent.j2).

user_submit_only.description: If true, this broker requires consumer-direct (e.g., notarized) submission; tool generates but does not send.

last_verified.description: ISO date the broker entry was last hand-verified by a maintainer.

maintainer.description: GitHub @handle of the broker entry's maintainer.
